title: Command Center
description: Everything at once: every service from outside, every machine from inside, and what is firing.

panels.title: Availability, 24 h
panels.description: Share of all probes that succeeded over the last day.

panels.title: Services
panels.description: Click a product or service to open its page.

targets.expr: (min by (service) (probe_success{job="blackbox"})) + on (service) group_left (product) (0 * max by (service, product) (probe_success{job="blackbox"}))
(count by (service) (probe_success{job="blackbox"})) + on (service) group_left (product) (0 * max by (service, product) (probe_success{job="blackbox"}))
(max by (service) (probe_duration_seconds{job="blackbox"})) + on (service) group_left (product) (0 * max by (service, product) (probe_success{job="blackbox"}))
(max by (service) (quantile_over_time(0.95, probe_duration_seconds{job="blackbox"}[24h]))) + on (service) group_left (product) (0 * max by (service, product) (probe_success{job="blackbox"}))
(avg by (service) (avg_over_time(probe_success{job="blackbox"}[24h]))) + on (service) group_left (product) (0 * max by (service, product) (probe_success{job="blackbox"}))
(avg by (service) (avg_over_time(probe_success{job="blackbox"}[7d]))) + on (service) group_left (product) (0 * max by (service, product) (probe_success{job="blackbox"}))
(min by (service) ((probe_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry{job="blackbox"} - time()) / 86400)) + on (service) group_left (product) (0 * max by (service, product) (probe_success{job="blackbox"}))
